svg.text: BioScout Arduino — current setup: 3 lamps + LCD 1602
DIGITAL — lamps on 13 / 12 / 11, LCD D7 on 10
Contrast on LCD pin 3 (V0): 1 kΩ → − rail, 4.7 kΩ → + rail
(2.2 kΩ → + if boxes still show · or the B103 pot: middle leg → V0)
Power: VSS(1), RW(5), K(16) → − rail · VDD(2) → + rail · A(15) → 220 Ω → + rail · D0–D3 (7–10) unconnected
Lamp colours are set in the app (default green / yellow / red). Blank LCD? Turn the contrast pot. · Blank screen or black boxes? Turn the contrast pot until the text appears.
